assumption_sensitivity.interpretation: The quoted change total moves with the rate assumption, as an estimate should. The no-charge cure total does not move, because it is zero by policy rather than by arithmetic -- there is no rate at which correcting our own nonconformance becomes billable.

assumptions: ASSUMPTION: the base package is modelled at 160 hours. The proposal states a fixed $24,000 fee and no hours, so this figure is an inference made solely to give change pricing an anchor. Replace it with a real number and every quote below moves.

ASSUMPTION: the implied blended rate ($150/h) is consistent with a roughly 40/40/20 mix of evidence_analyst / assessment_engineer / lead_reviewer time, which blends to about $147/h. If the real staffing mix differs, the role rates and the base-hours assumption must be re-reconciled together -- changing one alone silently breaks the other.

ASSUMPTION: 8% coordination overhead on added work covers re-planning, re-baselining the affected artifacts, and the extra handoffs a mid-engagement change creates. It is not applied to no-charge corrections.

FACT from the repository: the $24,000 base, the $4,000 separately-authorized readout option, the 40/40/20 milestone split and the travel exclusion are quoted from COMMERCIAL.md. They are PROPOSED and NOT ACCEPTED; quoting them here does not make them agreed.

BOUNDARY: correcting a TJLabs-authored artifact that fails an agreed acceptance criterion is never a change item, whenever it is raised. This worksheet enforces that rather than leaving it to negotiation.
